topics.definition: Process synchronization coordinates multiple processes so shared data remains consistent.
topics.example: Two processes updating the same file

topics.definition: A critical section is the part of a program where shared resources are accessed.
tips: Only one process should execute at a time.

topics.definition: A mutex is a locking mechanism that allows only one thread or process to access a resource.
tips: Always release the lock after use.

topics.definition: A semaphore is a synchronization primitive used to control access to shared resources.
A monitor is a high-level synchronization construct that provides mutual exclusion.
A classic synchronization problem where producers generate data and consumers use it.
A synchronization problem demonstrating resource sharing and deadlock.
Use appropriate synchronization mechanisms and minimize time spent in critical sections.
